        self.assertEqual(keccak256(b'transfer(address,uint256)')[:4].hex(), 'a9059cbb')
        self.assertEqual(keccak256(b'foo(bool)')[:4].hex(), '45557578')
        self.assertEqual(keccak256(b'Transfer(address,address,uint256)').hex(),
                         'ddf252ad1be2c89b69c2b068fc378daa952ba7f163c4a11628f55a4df523b3ef')

    def test_overloads(self):
        operations = load_contract(ROOT / 'assets/test.abi')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(AbiError, 'More than one function'):
            select(operations, 'bar', 'function')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(AbiError, 'invalid function signature'):
            select(operations, 'bar(string)', 'function')
        function = select(operations, 'bar(string):(uint256)', 'function')
        self.assertEqual(function.hash()[:4].hex(), 'd473a8ed')

    def test_tuple_json(self):
        obj = [{'type': 'function', 'name': 'f', 'inputs': [
            {'name': 'x', 'type': 'tuple', 'components': [
                {'name': 'n', 'type': 'uint256'}, {'name': 'b', 'type': 'bool'}]}], 'outputs': []}]
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            p = Path(directory) / 'tuple.abi'
            p.write_text(json.dumps(obj))
            function = select(load_contract(p), 'f', 'function')
            self.assertEqual(function.call_signature(), 'f((uint256,bool))')
            self.assertEqual(function.hash()[:4].hex(), 'c5cba275')

    def test_anonymous_event(self):
        event = select(load_contract(ROOT / 'assets/event.abi'), 'Event', 'event')
        result = decode_event(event, [word(1)], b'\0' * 12 + b'\x11' * 20)
        self.assertEqual([(n, str(v)) for n, v in result], [('a', 'true'), ('b', '11' * 20)])
        self.assertEqual(topic_bytes('0x ' + word(1).hex() + '\n'), word(1))

    def test_named_event(self):
        event = select(load_contract(ROOT / 'assets/eip20.abi'), 'Transfer', 'event')
        result = decode_event(event, [event.hash(), word(1), word(2)], word(42))
        self.assertEqual([str(v) for n, v in result], ['0' * 39 + '1', '0' * 39 + '2', '2a'])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(AbiError, 'Invalid data'):
            decode_event(event, [word(0), word(1), word(2)], word(42))


class CliTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_encode(self):
        p = run_cli('encode', 'params', '-v', 'bool', '1')
        self.assertEqual((p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr), (0, word(1).hex() + '\n', ''))

    def test_decode(self):
        p = run_cli('decode', 'params', '-t', 'uint', word(42).hex())
        self.assertEqual((p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr), (0, 'uint256 2a\n', ''))

    def test_function_extra_arguments(self):
        p = run_cli('encode', 'function', 'assets/test.abi', 'foo', '-p', 'true', '-p', 'false')
        self.assertEqual((p.returncode, p.stdout), (0, '45557578' + word(1).hex() + '\n'))

    def test_hex_error_layers(self):
        p = run_cli('encode', 'params', '-v', 'uint256', '1')
        self.assertEqual(p.returncode, 1)
        self.assertEqual(p.stderr, 'Error: Hex parsing error: Odd number of digits\n\nCaused by:\n    Odd number of digits\n')
        p = run_cli('decode', 'params', '-t', 'uint256', '1')
        self.assertEqual(p.stderr, 'Error: Odd number of digits\n')

    def test_help_and_version(self):
        p = run_cli('--version')
        self.assertEqual((p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr), (0, 'ethabi-cli 18.0.0\n', ''))
        p = run_cli('encode', 'params', '--help')
        self.assertEqual(p.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn('-v <type1> <param1> -v <type2> <param2> ...\n', p.stdout)
        p = run_cli('encode', 'params', '-h')
        self.assertNotIn('-v <type1>', p.stdout)

    def test_cli_validation(self):
        p = run_cli('encode', 'params', '-v', 'bool')
        self.assertEqual(p.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn('requires 2 values, but 1 was provided', p.stderr)
        p = run_cli('decode', 'params')
        self.assertEqual(p.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn('The following required arguments were not provided:\n    <data>', p.stderr)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
